title: ATT&CK coverage
description: Generated by .forgejo/scripts/attack-coverage.py from the alert rules' labels: don't edit it in Grafana, change the rules and run the script.

list.name: platform
list.label: Platforms
list.description: The platforms whose techniques the matrix shows (ATT&CK Navigator's platform filter).

panels.title: ATT&CK matrix (Enterprise 20.0)
panels.description: Every technique on the selected platforms, as ATT&CK Navigator draws them. Green: a tested rule covers it (in every tactic it's in), yellow: only untested rules, a coloured edge: only its sub-techniques are covered (they're listed under it). A red edge and count: its alerts that fired in the time range (ALERTS, any rule with this technique, Falco's included; revoked IDs count for their replacements). Hover for the rules, click for the technique on attack.mitre.org. Techniques a rule covers or that fired are shown whatever the platforms.

panels.title: Detections by tactic
panels.description: From the rules in apps/base/monitoring/vmalert-logs/rules, apps/base/monitoring/vmalert/rules. tested: the date the rule was last triggered on purpose and reached ntfy (its runbook annotation says how).
